name: Puri Lime Life
description: Cleaner-style premium utility composition rebuilt in Puri's black, graphite and electric-lime visual language. Bold short copy, deep contrast, soft lime light, a large black iPhone and sparse editorial lifestyle photo cards.
decorationsHint: Puri-only palette: matte black #050604, graphite #171A15, electric lime #C9F31D and restrained warm white. Use broad soft gradient fields, a luminous lime halo behind the phone, subtle translucent bubbles and at most two rounded editorial family-photo cards. No neon rainbow, no blue or purple, no generic 3D cleaning props, no fake awards or ratings.
